643-3510-4288-8168.easyPrerequisites: You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
643-3510-4288-8168.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each permanent that entered is a Saproling through Maskwood Nexus and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Sarinth Greatwurm to trigger.
Resolve a Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, replacing the artifact token creation with that many 5/5 Dragons through Draconic Visitor.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1957-4050-6273--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant ability, gaining at least one life and causing at least one opponent to lose at least one life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

1479-4826-5700-5701-7885.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4826-5700-5701-7885.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Down in the Valley trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

3532-5078-6259-7864.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Ravenhill Flock triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2232-7827-7830-7834.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7830-7834.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

215-3151-3499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Elves.
215-3151-3499.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Elvish Archdruid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Elvish Archdruid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control
with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

3259-3480-7759.easyPrerequisites: Royal Talon Fighter Jet is a creature.
3259-3480-7759.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-7759.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-5189-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ghave.
When Ghave dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

240-643-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Maskwood Nexus, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-643-2034.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

2843-3175-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1339-2034-2122-7315.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2034-2122-7315.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

628-2511-7215.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Gnarlbark Elm.
When Gnarlbark Elm dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-2999-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2999-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

454-1651-4702-4891.description:
Turn Atsushi into an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Atsushi by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Put the Atsushi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Atsushi token dies, it triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Atsushi.
Repeat from step 2.

1062-3017-3487-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-3017-3487-5674.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

1395-1987-4423-5034.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sol Ring by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sol Ring.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

985-5078-6595.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Lyse's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

719-3767-3918-5116.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
719-3767-3918-5116.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
719-3767-3918-5116.description:
Activate Trazyn using Gilded Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1651-3715-5365-6260.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1651-3715-5365-6260.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting two +1/+1 counters on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

618-5147-5887.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Werefox Bodyguard.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Werefox Bodyguard token.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2034-3537-6115.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ozox, adding {C}{C}.
When Ozox dies, it triggers, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblebones creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jumblebones, adding {C}{C}.
When Jumblebones dies, it triggers, returning Ozox from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Bog Initiate by paying {1}, adding {B}.
Cast Ozox by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

215-391-729-2404.notablePrerequisites:
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five other creatures.
215-391-729-2404.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Great Oak Guardian to your hand.
Cast Great Oak Guardian by paying {5}{G}.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers itself, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more creatures, this combo will net infinite green mana, which you then may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Blossom Dryad any number of times.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1409-1633-2039-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional Spirit.
You have no cards in hand.
Torrential Gearhulk is paired with Deadeye Navigator.
392-1409-1633-2039-5195.description:
Activate Torrential Gearhulk by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Torrential Gearhulk enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Torrential Gearhulk.
Resolve a Torrential Gearhulk trigger, casting Hanabi Blast from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Storm-Kiln Aritst and Birgi trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, dealing 2 damage to any target, returning Hanabi Blast to your hand, and then causing you to discard Hanabi Blast.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

112-565-1283-1434.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {4}, targeting Chromatic Orrery.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens using their second abilities, or target any other permanent.

3340-3542-5184.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
3340-3542-5184.description:
Activate six lands by tapping them, creating twelve Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate eleven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {7}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Repeat.

1651-1766-2382-4840.description:
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Mimic Vat by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Myr Battlesphere with haste.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Myrs, untapping Mimic Vat.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Myrs, untapping Thran Dynamo.
Repeat.

15-1339-4875-5256.notablePrerequisites:
"Human" chosen with Conspiracy.
You have a way to draw a card.
15-1339-4875-5256.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Insect.
Laid to Rest triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Insect's power.
Repeat from step 3.

24-2988.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number, and causing you to gain life equal to the number you chose due to Purity if you chose the largest number.
If you didn't choose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals that much damage to each opponent who chose the largest number.

1621-2506.description:
Cast Wispweaver Angel by paying {4}{W}{W}.
Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Molten Echoes.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another creature you control if possible.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel with haste that will be exiled at the next end step.
The token copy of Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, triggering itself, blinking the nontoken Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

813-1987-2510-4714.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
813-1987-2510-4714.description:
Activate Mana Geode by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mana Geode and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Mana Geode enters the battlefield, scry 1.
Repeat.
